# Project AIP

> Project AIP is an industrial asset inspection and QA/QC workflow platform for sectors such as oil & gas, mining, protective coatings & NDT, and structural welding.

**This website is in pre-launch and is not yet ready for public release.**

While the site is in pre-launch, please do not crawl, index, cache, or use its
content for AI training or retrieval. Content and claims are still being
reviewed and may change before launch. See `/robots.txt` for the current
crawler policy.

This notice will be replaced with a full content map when the site goes live.
